1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2011.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2011

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lima ratus sembilan puluh enam juta tiga

ratus satu ribu ringgit (RM 596,301,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada Kumpulan

Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan

Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2011 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 133,452,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 126,030,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran-bayaran lain RM 1,431,000

Perbelanjaan lain RM 40,613,000

Hartanah, loji dan peralatan RM 294,775,000

______________________

Jumlah RM 596,301,000

Dibuat 6 Jun 2011

[KSM/PUU/T/01/01/01 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)58/XVI]

Datuk Dr. Subramaniam a/l K.V. Sathasivam

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security Act

1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2011.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2011

2. A sum not exceeding five hundred and ninety six million three hundred and one

thousand ringgit (RM 596,301,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security Fund for

expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2011 as

provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 133,452,000

Supplies and services RM 126,030,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 1,431,000

Other expenditures RM 40,613,000

Landed property, plant and equipment RM 294,775,000

______________________

Total RM 596,301,000

Made 6 June 2011

[KSM/PUU/T/01/01/01 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)58/XVI]

Datuk Dr. Subramaniam a/l K.V. Sathasivam

Minister of Human Resources
